title: Graph fragment
description: Scripts, tasks, modules and what they read, as one graph: the words its claims use. A node is named by its kind and what names it; an edge by the kinds it joins.

kind.description: calls: a script calls a script. runs: a script runs a task. executes: a task's run is a script. depends: a task needs another first. imports: a script uses a module. reads: anything reads a file, fileset, variable or operation.
